_doc.purpose: Minimal Agent_Bench patches that remain necessary on pinned OpenClaw v2026.9.2.

fields.file: relative path under patch/ to the unified diff

upstream_native: custom sandbox backend registry and filesystem bridge SDK
_doc.agent_bench_plugin: agent-bench-singularity overrides the built-in docker sandbox backend through OpenClaw's public plugin SDK and routes exec/fs operations through the existing Agent_Bench external execution bridge.
_doc.migration_policy: Do not patch OpenClaw core when a pinned public SDK extension point exists. Every remaining binary patch is required and build failure is intentional when its anchor moves.

patches.summary: coerce JSON-stringified nested array/object tool arguments before schema validation for Qwen tool calls
preserve request-level raw OpenAI-compatible serving telemetry used by Agent_Bench measurements
